column1: # Language syntax keys and the role each one gets in Powder (see ROLES in generate_theme.py).
# Key names come from the languages bundled with IntelliJ IDEA and the colour schemes of Nord, Dracula and
# Catppuccin. Every key listed here gets an explicit colour, so it never falls back to a Darcula colour.
# Languages not listed still follow the DEFAULT_* colours. Format: key<TAB>role.
